title: Ever Works — Mission Template
description: Schema for `mission.yml` in every Mission template. Mirrors the user-settable fields on the platform's Mission entity (packages/agent/src/entities/mission.entity.ts).

summary.description: One-sentence description shown on the template card.

schedule.description: Cron expression. Required when type=SCHEDULED. Ignored for ONE_SHOT.

autoBuildWorks.description: When true, Ideas the Mission emits that pass guardrails become Works without per-Idea approval. Templates default this to false unless the BRIEF explicitly explains the trade-off.

outstandingIdeasCap.description: Cap on pending (PENDING/QUEUED) Ideas this Mission may hold open at once. 0 means 'no cap'.

guardrailsOverride.description: Partial override of the tenant-global Work generation guardrails. Mirrors WorkGuardrails.

suggestedAgentTemplates.description: Agent template slugs from `ever-works/agents` that this Mission expects on the team. The wizard offers to create them on activation.
